content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the absence of a version check for the application ID in the EDIF (Enhanced Device Interface Framework) implementation. The original code only checked if the application ID matched a predefined value (EDIF_APP_ID) but did not validate the version of the application. This could lead to compatibility issues if different versions of the application were used, potentially causing unexpected behavior or failures. The patch introduced a version field and added checks to ensure that the application version matches the expected value (EDIF_VERSION1), thereby enhancing the robustness of the interface and preventing issues related to version mismatches.
